stories.title: Infant Goes from 110 Seizures a Day to Seizure-Free with Experimental Treatment
stories.label: health
stories.summary: A baby named Adnan was having a seizure almost every 13 minutes from the day he was born. Doctors at a Dubai hospital gave him a still-experimental drug, and his seizures stopped completely that very day. A week later, and the week after that, they still haven't come back. It's a huge relief for his family and a hopeful sign for other babies with the same rare condition.
stories.why_good: A real medical treatment actually worked and gave a suffering infant his health back, not a study or a hope for the future.

stories.title: WWII Tryst at the Center of 80+Year Mystery That's Now United Two Families
stories.label: people
stories.summary: An 81-year-old man in England grew up never knowing who his biological father was. Across the ocean in Canada, a family had been quietly wondering about a baby their grandfather may have left behind during World War II. After decades of searching, the two families finally connected and confirmed they were related. Rodney Anderson has now met his long-lost relatives, closing a gap that spanned 80 years, a war, and an entire ocean. It's a beautiful reminder that even the oldest family mysteries can have happy endings.
stories.why_good: A real, completed reunion that healed an 80-year family mystery with no suffering at its core, just connection and closure.
